sample_unit: published ophthalmic case studies (each tested on 15 LLMs)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses versus recommended public reading level
links.effect: Readability of all 15 tested LLMs was above the AMA-recommended eighth-grade reading level for public consumers.
links.quote: Readability of all tested programs were above the AMA (American Medical Association) reading level recommendations to public consumers of eight grade.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of 15 LLMs on challenging ophthalmology clinical cases published in JAMA Ophthalmology, evaluating accuracy and readability without evaluating a specific deployment practice.
